title: Payment Terms, Credit Limits and Invoicing Arrangements by Programme Tier
content:
Each tier of the Corporate Travel Programmes publishes the terms on which the company is invoiced: the days it has to pay, the monthly interest an overdue balance carries, the largest unpaid balance the programme may carry, whether bookings are gathered onto one consolidated invoice, the days within which an invoice line may be disputed, and the markup added where the company elects to be invoiced in a currency other than the contract currency.

The columns below carry the six tiers of the Corporate Travel Programmes in rank order: the Business Starter Programme, the Business Team Programme, the Business Pro Programme, the Business Enterprise Programme, the Business Enterprise Plus Programme and the Business Global Programme.

|  | Starter | Team | Pro | Enterprise | Enterprise Plus | Global |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Days from the invoice date by which payment is due | 0 | 14 | 30 | 30 | 45 | 60 |
| Monthly interest on an overdue balance | 1.5 per cent | 1.5 per cent | 1.5 per cent | 1.25 per cent | 1 per cent | 1 per cent |
| Largest unpaid balance the programme may carry | 2500.00 USD | 15000.00 USD | 75000.00 USD | 350000.00 USD | 1250000.00 USD | 5000000.00 USD |
| Every booking billed on one consolidated invoice | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Calendar days after the invoice date within which a line may be disputed | 14 | 21 | 30 | 45 | 60 | 90 |
| Added where the company elects another invoicing currency | 3 per cent | 2.5 per cent | 2 per cent | 1.5 per cent | 1 per cent | 0.5 per cent |

## Notes to the terms

1. Payment terms run from 0 days on the Business Starter Programme, where the invoice is due on its own date, through 14 days, 30 days on both the Business Pro Programme and the Business Enterprise Programme, and 45 days, to 60 days on the Business Global Programme.
2. The monthly interest published for an overdue balance is 1.5 per cent on the Business Starter, Business Team and Business Pro Programmes, 1.25 per cent on the Business Enterprise Programme, and 1.0 per cent on both the Business Enterprise Plus Programme and the Business Global Programme.
3. The published credit limit rises from 2500.00 USD on the Business Starter Programme through 15000.00 USD, 75000.00 USD, 350000.00 USD and 1250000.00 USD to 5000000.00 USD on the Business Global Programme.
4. Consolidated invoicing is published for the Business Pro Programme and every tier above it. The Business Starter Programme and the Business Team Programme are not published with it.
5. The dispute window widens from 14 calendar days on the Business Starter Programme through 21, 30, 45 and 60 to 90 calendar days on the Business Global Programme.
6. The currency markup narrows as the tier rises: 3.0 per cent, 2.5 per cent, 2.0 per cent, 1.5 per cent, 1.0 per cent and 0.5 per cent.
